verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at developers.heap.io (HTTP 200) with a Heap Documentation index, and a markdown docs root (docs.md) also responds. Individual doc pages are served as .md files (e.g., web.md, api-reference.md), so an agent can be pointed at clean, machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or promoting agent-oriented docs usage, no llms-full.txt evidence, and no independent or community corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
